note: Tuscarawas County does not zone unincorporated land; township zoning is published only as PDF resolutions and maps (Sandy, Dover, Lawrence, Sugarcreek townships). Dover city publishes its zoning as a static 2019 PDF map. The county GIS server (gis.co.tuscarawas.oh.us) has parcel, tax, street and aerial layers but no zoning district layer. No city (New Philadelphia, Uhrichsville, Dover) zoning FeatureServer was found. The Zoning_Districts FeatureServer found on services.arcgis.com does not cover the county (no features at the county sample point).
